name: @symbiosika/bugreport-client
description: Browser SDK (vanilla TS) for @symbiosika/bugreport: overlay UI, screen/audio capture, context collection, upload
author: Symbiosika GmbH (https://www.symbiosika.de)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --external @symbiosika/bugreport-core && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/bugreport-client.browser.js --format esm --target browser --minify && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
